traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills crowded; whitish to pale cream when young, becoming clay- to cinnamon-brown with maturity; edges whitish
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills crowded; whitish to pale cream when young, becoming clay- to cinnamon-brown with maturity; edges whitish

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Convex when young, later broadly convex to flat, sometimes obtusely umbonate; smooth, viscid when moist; whitish-buff, pale tan, usually darker centrally and paler toward margin
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Convex when young, later broadly convex to flat, sometimes obtusely umbonate; smooth, viscid when moist; whitish-buff, pale tan, usually darker centrally and paler toward margin

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnate to emarginate
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to emarginate

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical to slightly clavate, white to pale cream; pruinose or floccose-granular near apex, fibrillose below; base sometimes enlarged with white mycelial threads; ring absent
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical to slightly clavate, white to pale cream; pruinose or floccose-granular near apex, fibrillose below; base sometimes enlarged with white mycelial threads; ring absent

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore print reddish-brown to clay-brown
traits.raw: 🟤🟠 Spore print reddish-brown to clay-brown

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal with hardwoods and conifers; forests, woodland edges, dunes and grassy places beneath trees; solitary, scattered or gregariously; summer to late autumn
traits.raw: 🌲🌳 Mycorrhizal with hardwoods and conifers; forests, woodland edges, dunes and grassy places beneath trees; solitary, scattered or gregariously; summer to late autumn

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Poisonous; causes gastrointestinal upset, including nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhoea
traits.raw: 😵 Poisonous; causes gastrointestinal upset, including nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhoea

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Gills often exuding clear droplets in moist weather that dry as rusty-brown spots
traits.raw: 💧 Gills often exuding clear droplets in moist weather that dry as rusty-brown spots

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body medium to large; stipe ~4–13 cm long and ~0.5–2 cm thick
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body medium to large; stipe ~4–13 cm long and ~0.5–2 cm thick

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap ∅ ~3–11 cm
traits.raw: 📐 Cap ∅ ~3–11 cm

traits.label: Flesh
traits.text: White, thick and firm, unchanging when cut
traits.raw: 🔪 White, thick and firm, unchanging when cut

traits.label: Chemical reactions
traits.text: No macroscopic reagents reaction
traits.raw: 🧪 No macroscopic reagents reaction

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Radish-like
traits.raw: 👃 Radish-like

traits.label: Taste
traits.text: Radish-like
traits.raw: 👅 Radish-like
